propositions: Plan-review gate currently exempts bug tickets from substantive review, yielding bare exempt-PASS verdicts with zero LLM calls
FixedBench shows 35-65% over-action rate (plans that add mechanisms without establishing need), but plan-review gate lacks a criterion to detect this absence of motivation
Current bug review short-circuits at workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck for ticket_type=bug, bypassing both DET floor and LLM criteria evaluation
Necessity criterion must ask whether a plan demonstrates why the change is needed (distinct from asserted-capability, which checks if an implementation already exists)
Bug review tier must run DET floor + necessity probe as advisory-only findings (never blocking), allowing bugs to receive substantive review without enforcement
Necessity probe must accept well-motivated outcomes (with reproduction + motivation) and justified no-op / docs-test-only changes while flagging unmotivated mechanism additions
